tasks.label: 编译当前章节普通版
args: $base='${fileBasenameNoExtension}'; if ($base -notmatch '_内容$') { Write-Error '当前文件不是 *_内容.tex，取消编译'; exit 1 }; $target=($base -replace '_内容$','')+'.tex'; Write-Host ('编译: '+$target); & latexmk -xelatex -synctex=1 -interaction=nonstopmode -file-line-error $target; exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: 编译当前章节答案版
args: $base='${fileBasenameNoExtension}'; if ($base -notmatch '_内容$') { Write-Error '当前文件不是 *_内容.tex，取消编译'; exit 1 }; $target=($base -replace '_内容$','')+'(答案版).tex'; Write-Host ('编译: '+$target); & latexmk -xelatex -synctex=1 -interaction=nonstopmode -file-line-error $target; exit $LASTEXITCODE
